title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
author: Scott Lynch
summary: A brilliant young thief leads a gang of con artists who rob the nobles of a canal city, until a mysterious figure begins killing the underworld's leaders. Locke's carefully planned cons are swept up in a bigger, bloodier fight.
readIf: you want a profane, funny, plotty fantasy with elaborate cons and tight friendships.
skipIf: you dislike swearing, graphic violence or a book that cuts back and forth between past and present.

pairings.reason: A somewhat gentler heist fantasy with a crew of skilled young outcasts and a tight plan.
Another cynical, funny fantasy that revels in unheroic characters and sharp dialogue.
A cleaner, more hopeful take on the thieves-against-the-powerful idea.
